component.name: Calcium
component.summary: A text editor that loves math

description.p: Markdown documents in which any line can be a calculation. Write 2 + 2 => and the answer appears after the arrow; change a definition and every dependent answer follows. Units are algebra (88 mph in km/hour, or furlongs per fortnight), arithmetic is exact, and equations solve symbolically — with units on.
Documents are plain Markdown: mail them, commit them to git, open them in any editor. The answers travel inside the text.
